top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a verified, reproduced discovery of a new class of matter: the Kane-Mele prediction of the quantum spin Hall effect and Z2 topological insulators, tested by Molenkamp's first observation in HgTe wells, with theory, band structure and transport in agreement. The narrowed citation keeps each of the three names defensible for their own part. P002 (twisted bilayer graphene) is scientifically strong but one or two years less settled on device reproducibility and credit; P003 (optical lattice clocks) has the cleanest credit but is an incremental precision refinement; no award is the weakest outcome given a mature candidate.
